selection_rationale: Short-horizon dose companion of the mechanism round: same 48 mothers, same five arms, 16 clones each, every sweep recorded. Measures the first-sweep drift a_1 per mother and arm to test the chain dJ_pre(arm) -> a_1(arm) -> delta_q_B(arm) against the frozen linear sensitivity prediction. Not an endpoint measurement.
interpretation: first-sweep conditional drift per mother and rearrangement arm; identification of the local-allocation mechanism, no endpoint claims
